description.zh: 绕过一次解码后校验的 WAF/中间件链：双重百分号编码，第二次解码发生在应用层。成功判据：登录成功。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses WAF/middleware chains that validate after a single decode by double percent-encoding; the second decode happens at the app layer. Success: login succeeds. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 大小写不同的参数名命中大小写不敏感的取参层。成功判据：会话从 URL 采信。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Differently-cased parameter names hit case-insensitive extraction layers. Success: the session is honored from the URL. Failure condition: broadly defeated once modern WAFs normalize requests; it only works against case-sensitive custom regex rules.

description.zh: 头部写两个 alg 键（RS256 在前 none 在后），不同 JSON 解析器取值不同，绕过头部静态校验；成功判据：任一解析路径按 none 接受。现代库现状：PyJWT 2+ / jsonwebtoken 8+ 默认拒绝该形态，仅自研校验或旧库成立。
description.en: Two alg keys make parsers disagree (first vs last), bypassing static header validation. Success: some parse path accepts it as none. Modern-library reality: PyJWT 2+ and jsonwebtoken 8+ reject this form by default, so it only succeeds against hand-rolled verifiers or outdated libraries.

description.zh: 完全省略第三个点段（仅两段），绕过“必须三段”与空签名段两类校验；成功判据：两段令牌被接受且 role 生效。现代库现状：PyJWT 2+ / jsonwebtoken 8+ 默认拒绝该形态，仅自研校验或旧库成立。
description.en: Drops the third segment entirely, evading both the must-have-three-segments and empty-signature checks. Success: the two-segment token is accepted and the role applies. Modern-library reality: PyJWT 2+ and jsonwebtoken 8+ reject this form by default, so it only succeeds against hand-rolled verifiers or outdated libraries.

description.zh: 签名段以 AA 占位并增补 iss/exp 声明，改变 base64 特征的同时满足宽松校验；成功判据：令牌以 admin 权限通过。现代库现状：PyJWT 2+ / jsonwebtoken 8+ 默认拒绝该形态，仅自研校验或旧库成立。
description.en: Uses an AA placeholder signature and adds iss/exp claims to alter the base64 signature while satisfying lenient checks. Success: the token passes with admin privileges. Modern-library reality: PyJWT 2+ and jsonwebtoken 8+ reject this form by default, so it only succeeds against hand-rolled verifiers or outdated libraries.

description.zh: 头部变形：嵌套 JWT 伪装 — 把伪造令牌藏进外层头部 nested 字段（二次解包型实现），规避对 payload 直接含 role 的检测；成功判据：实现解包后接受内层令牌。现代库现状：PyJWT 2+ / jsonwebtoken 8+ 默认拒绝该形态，仅自研校验或旧库成立。
description.en: Hides the forged token in a nested header field for unwrap-style implementations, evading direct role-in-payload detection. Success: the impl unwraps and accepts the inner token. Modern-library reality: PyJWT 2+ and jsonwebtoken 8+ reject this form by default, so it only succeeds against hand-rolled verifiers or outdated libraries.

description.zh: 绕过单次解码后匹配 %0d%0aSet-Cookie 的 WAF：应用二次解码时双重编码逐层还原；成功判据：响应头多出攻击者可控的 sessionid/JSESSIONID Cookie（响应中出现两个 Set-Cookie 行）。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs matching %0d%0aSet-Cookie after a single decode: double encoding peels back when the application decodes twice; success criterion: an attacker-controlled sessionid/JSESSIONID cookie appears as an extra Set-Cookie line in the response. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 绕过单次解码匹配 %0d%0aSet-Cookie 的 WAF 规则：二次解码漏洞下双重编码还原；成功判据：响应多出注入的管理 Cookie 行。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules matching %0d%0aSet-Cookie after one decode: double encoding restores under double-decode flaws; success criterion: an injected admin cookie line appears in the response. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 二次解码还原 // 前缀。判据：解码后跳转攻击域。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Second decode restores the // prefix. Success: navigates to attacker host after decoding. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 分别作为完整 Authorization 值发送，并与无头、空头、随机无效令牌及有效测试令牌对照。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。
description.en: Send each as the complete Authorization value and compare with absent, empty, random-invalid, and valid test-token controls. Controlled sample: establishes a baseline or control and is not a standalone bypass technique.

description.zh: 头部声明 ES256 而签名填充 64 字节，验证是否只按头部声明做长度校验；成功判据：伪签名通过椭圆曲线校验路径。现代库现状：PyJWT 2+ / jsonwebtoken 8+ 默认拒绝该形态，仅自研校验或旧库成立。
description.en: Claims ES256 in the header with 64 filler signature bytes to test header-only length validation. Success: the fake signature passes the EC verification path. Modern-library reality: PyJWT 2+ and jsonwebtoken 8+ reject this form by default, so it only succeeds against hand-rolled verifiers or outdated libraries.

description.zh: 路径段 .. 双重编码穿越回调前缀，二次解码后指向外域；成功判据：授权响应落到攻击者域。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double-encodes the traversal to escape the callback prefix after a second decode. Success: the auth response lands on the attacker host. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

Controlled sample: establishes a baseline or control and is not a standalone bypass technique.

description.zh: 绕过一次解码后匹配的 WAF：第二层解码发生在后端路由。成功判据：管理路径返回 200。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs matching after one decode; the second decode happens at backend routing. Success: admin path returns 200. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 对边界设备复测同一组变体；边界与后端判定不一致即确认边界规则可被差异化利用。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。
description.en: Replay the same variants against the edge device; disagreement between edge and backend verdicts confirms differential abuse of edge rules. Controlled sample: establishes a baseline or control and is not a standalone bypass technique.

description.zh: 绕过小写后缀精确匹配的缓存规则：大写扩展名仍按静态处理。成功判据：返回缓存的动态页面。失效条件：现代 WAF 请求归一化后普遍失效，仅对自研大小写敏感正则成立。
description.en: Bypasses cache rules matching lowercase suffixes exactly since uppercase extensions still classify as static. Success: the dynamic page returns from cache. Failure condition: broadly defeated once modern WAFs normalize requests; it only works against case-sensitive custom regex rules.

description.zh: JSON 结构与编码注入改变协议派生。成功判据：响应或跳转按注入 scheme 构造。现代库现状：CF-Visitor JSON 注入属 2016 年代 CVE 形态，现代 Cloudflare 已净化该头，仅旧版本或自建解析层成立。
description.en: JSON structural and encoding injection alters scheme derivation. Success: responses or redirects are built with the injected scheme. Modern reality: the CF-Visitor JSON injection is a 2016-era CVE pattern; current Cloudflare sanitizes this header, so it only succeeds on legacy or self-built parsers.

description.zh: 绕过单次解码匹配 %0d/%0a 的 WAF：应用再解码一层时双重/三重编码还原出真实 CRLF；成功判据：响应头被拆分（出现受控头名或响应体错位）。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs matching %0d/%0a after one decode: double/triple encoding restores real CRLF when the application decodes again; success criterion: the response gets split (controlled header name appears or the body shifts). Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 绕过匹配 %0d%0aLocation 的规则：双重/三重编码在二次解码场景还原；成功判据：响应 30x 跳转到攻击域。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses rules matching %0d%0aLocation: double/triple encoding restores under double-decode scenarios; success criterion: a 30x response redirecting to the attacker host. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 绕过一次解码后拦截 %0d%0a 的 WAF：第二层解码发生在代理注入点。成功判据：注入头在服务端生效。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs blocking %0d%0a after one decode; the second decode happens at the proxy injection point. Success: the injected header takes effect backend. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 编码 NUL 在解码层截断主机名造成解析异常。成功判据：异常响应进入缓存。失效条件：现代栈对头部值中的 NUL 直接返回 400，仅宽容解析层成立。
description.en: Encoded NULs truncate the hostname at the decode layer causing parse failures. Success: the failure response enters the cache. Failure condition: modern stacks answer 400 outright to NUL bytes inside header values, so only lenient parsers accept this.

description.zh: 伪造 X-Varnish 链使边缘认为是内部代理链。成功判据：边缘按内部请求处理并缓存投毒内容。失效条件：默认 Varnish 不信任请求侧 X-Varnish 头，仅当自定义 VCL 显式采信该头时成立。
description.en: Forged X-Varnish chains make the edge treat the request as an internal proxy chain. Success: the edge processes it internally and caches poisoned content. Failure condition: stock Varnish never trusts the request-side X-Varnish header; this only works when a custom VCL explicitly honors it.

description.zh: 双重编码的 CR/LF/NUL 在缓存规范化层还原造成键差异。成功判据：投毒键与受害键归并为同一缓存条目。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double-encoded CR/LF/NUL resolve at cache normalization causing key divergence. Success: poisoned and victim keys merge into one cache entry. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 绕过只解码一次即匹配 %0d%0a 的 WAF：应用在 WAF 之后又做一次解码（双重解码漏洞）时，%250d%250a/%25250d%25250a 逐层还原出 CRLF 完成响应分割；成功判据：响应头多出注入的 Content-Type/Set-Cookie 或响应体出现脚本。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs that decode once before matching %0d%0a: when the application decodes again after the WAF (double-decode flaw), %250d%250a/%25250d%25250a restore CRLF layer by layer for response splitting; success criterion: injected Content-Type/Set-Cookie headers or script content appear in the response. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 双重编码绕过一次解码后再匹配 CRLF 的 WAF；成功判据：应用二次解码后响应头注入成功。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double encoding survives WAFs that match CRLF after a single decode. Success: the header injects after the app's second decode. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 逐条放入已确认会进入响应头的测试参数，使用自有测试来源与无敏感 Cookie，检查原始响应头结构。命中判据：响应头出现注入的 Location/Set-Cookie 或正文被拆分。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。
description.en: Place each line separately in a confirmed response-header input, use a controlled origin and nonsensitive cookie, and inspect the raw header structure. Success check: the response headers contain the injected Location/Set-Cookie or the body is split. Controlled sample: establishes a baseline or control and is not a standalone bypass technique.

description.en: Double-encodes # so the first decode still looks like a target path. Success: the second parse splits out the attacker host via the fragment. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 控制符双重编码应对一次解码的 WAF；成功判据：二次解码后仍形成分隔跳转。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double-encoded controls survive single-decode WAFs. Success: after the second decode the separator still splits the redirect. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 三重百分号编码应对多次解码的网关，最终一次解码后为完整外部 URL；成功判据：跳转至攻击者域。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Triple percent-encoding survives multi-decode gateways, leaving a full external URL after the final decode. Success: redirect lands on the attacker host. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 协议明文 + 路径段多重编码，规避“整串要么全明文要么全编码”的检测分支；成功判据：解析后为 //host 形态并跳转。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Plaintext scheme plus multiply-encoded slashes straddles detection branches. Success: the parsed //host form triggers the redirect. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.
